theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K O : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ∃ (χ : Euclid P → ℝ) (O' : Set (Euclid P)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ O ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ IsOpen O' ∧ K ⊆ O' ∧ ∀ x ∈ O', χ x = 1
